Class Floor

java.lang.Object
Floor
public class Floor extends Object
The Floor class is a class containing an 2D array of tiles. This class is also responsible for player movement.

  • Constructor Details

    • Floor

      public Floor(int xBounds, int yBounds)
      This is the constructor for the Floor class. It creates a 2D array of tiles which will then be displayed on the screen. It initially constructs the aray full of empy spaces.
      Parameters:
      xBounds - This is the x/width of the floor
      yBounds - This is the y/Width of the year

  • Method Details

    • setTile

      public void setTile(int y, int x, Tile tile)
      This method assigns a tile based on the given parameter tile. From a given y, x, and tile, it adds the specific tiles onto the floor array.
      Parameters:
      y - is the y index to be specified by the user during the creation of a floor.
      x - is the x index to be specified by the user during the creation of a floor.
      tile - is an object of class tile or under class tile. It is added to the 2d array.

    • printFloor

      public void printFloor()
      This method prints the entire floor. It also generates the boarder for better clarity of the map.

    • movePlayer

      public void movePlayer(char input)
      This method moves the player tile's index dependin on the input char value. It finds the location of a player tile within the array then verifies, through the use of the VerifyMove() methid, and determines wether the desired move is valid. If true then it updates the position of the player tile.
      Parameters:
      input - This is a character input

    • SlayedBoss

      public void SlayedBoss()
      This method enables fast travel tile and disables the boss tile within the boss room. This function is only called when the conditions within the Area class are satisfied (When the boss is defeated, call this function in area).
